caption_draft: **Transaction-class leakage under session-disjoint evaluation.** (a) balanced accuracy, (b) mutual information, over 22 leave-one-session-out folds; (c, d) row-normalised confusion under the mechanism, for the two feature sets.
statistical_method: Random forest, 100 trees, min_samples_leaf 5; confusion summed over eight folds. Three-class chance balanced accuracy is 1/3.
